description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hammillewa, Eastern Nuwaragampalathe D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for specific parcels in Anuradhapura District. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, ownership details (mostly "The State"), and land registration particulars, making it clearly a land-related gazette under Type 4 classification.
